children: Overview
US biopharmaceutical firm's Q3 net loss narrowed from prior year
Company completed major restructuring, reducing future operating cash needs
Advancing merger with Avere Therapeutics, backed by $820 mln committed financing
Outlook
Combined company expected to operate as Avere and trade on Nasdaq as AVRX after merger
Company expects $820 mln financing to support AVR-001 development and future operations post-merger
Stockholder vote on merger scheduled for Dec 9, 2026; completion subject to approval and conditions
Result Drivers
LOWER R&D COSTS - Co said reduced research and development expenses were driven by restructuring, lower personnel and lab costs, and asset sales
RESTRUCTURING INITIATIVES - Workforce reductions, lease terminations and asset sales lowered future operating cash needs
MERGER-RELATED COSTS - Higher legal and professional fees linked to merger increased general and administrative expenses
